what: Every run of the caricature-warp checks, failures included. Bounds file unchanged since 679f718.

runs.failure: my precondition that the salience peak lies on the head or hat: with sigma 0.06 the head (11 px at 160 x 100) merges with the coat and the peak sits on the coat. The criterion itself held: magnification 5.18 at the peak, 5.14 at the head centre (bound 1.2).
runs.fix: grotesque sigma 0.06 to 0.035: the peak moves onto the head.

runs.result: one clamped step bulged too little at 640 x 400
runs.change: Composed steps (grotesque 4). A first composed version kept the one-step clamp per step; a new test of the composed map's own Jacobian (added with the steps, stricter than before) found its minimum determinant 0.001, under the committed 0.03. Fix: each step is clamped to c = 1 - 0.04^(1 / (2 steps)), so the composition keeps det >= 0.04. Per-step magnification at the head is then 1.62.

runs.result: 4 of 4 (identity, single-step fold-free on random salience with lambda 100, head magnified, composed map fold-free on the street and random salience)
